-- REQ: LANG-221 LANG-222 LANG-223 LANG-224 LANG-225
--[[ Block comment
over lines ]]
--[==[ level two ]] still comment ]==]
local M = {}

local function greet(name)
  local text = "Hello, " .. name .. "!\n\x41\u{1F600}"
  local single = 'it\'s'
  local long = [[
raw "text" \n stays
]]
  local level = [==[ contains ]] and ]=] ]==]
  return text, single, long, level
end

function M.sum(t)
  local total = 0
  for i, v in ipairs(t) do
    if v ~= nil and type(v) == "number" then
      total = total + v * 2 ^ 1 // 1 % 7
    elseif not v then
      goto continue
    end
    ::continue::
  end
  return total, 0x1p4, 3.14, 1e10, #t
end

print(greet("world"), M.sum({1, 2, nil}), string.format("%d", 42), math.pi, true, false)
return M
